# 150Aura SPI-NAND 25 分区 —— 直接作为内核命令行参数使用
# 来源：logs/vehicle-boot-150aura.log 中 "Creating 25 MTD partitions" 段
#       括号内名字保留真机原样（含尾点：rootfs. / opt. / spsdk. / spapp.）
#       合计 0x20000000 = 512 MiB，与 XTX XT26G04C 容量一致
#
# 用法：把下面这一行整体拼进 -append
mtdparts=sp_spinand.0:0x40000(nand_header),0x40000(xboot1),0xc0000(uboot1),0x1c0000(uboot2),0x80000(env),0x80000(env_redund),0x400000(ecos),0x480000(kernel),0x480000(rootfs.),0x80000(opt.),0x3000000(spsdk.),0x4040000(spapp.),0x1000000(nvm),0x40000(pq),0x40000(tcon),0x40000(iop_car),0x100000(runtime_cfg),0x40000(vi),0x980000(isp_logo),0x40000(vendordata),0xbc0000(pat_logo),0x40000(version_info),0x40000(vd_restore),0x100000(anm_logo),0x15540000(userdata)

# 分区表（起始偏移 - 结束偏移 - 大小 - 名字）
#   0x000000000-0x000040000  0x00040000  nand_header
#   0x000040000-0x000080000  0x00040000  xboot1
#   0x000080000-0x000140000  0x000c0000  uboot1
#   0x000140000-0x000300000  0x001c0000  uboot2
#   0x000300000-0x000380000  0x00080000  env
#   0x000380000-0x000400000  0x00080000  env_redund
#   0x000400000-0x000800000  0x00400000  ecos
#   0x000800000-0x000c80000  0x00480000  kernel
#   0x000c80000-0x001100000  0x00480000  rootfs.
#   0x001100000-0x001180000  0x00080000  opt.
#   0x001180000-0x004180000  0x03000000  spsdk.
#   0x004180000-0x0081c0000  0x04040000  spapp.
#   0x0081c0000-0x0091c0000  0x01000000  nvm
#   0x0091c0000-0x009200000  0x00040000  pq
#   0x009200000-0x009240000  0x00040000  tcon
#   0x009240000-0x009280000  0x00040000  iop_car
#   0x009280000-0x009380000  0x00100000  runtime_cfg
#   0x009380000-0x0093c0000  0x00040000  vi
#   0x0093c0000-0x009d40000  0x00980000  isp_logo
#   0x009d40000-0x009d80000  0x00040000  vendordata
#   0x009d80000-0x00a940000  0x00bc0000  pat_logo
#   0x00a940000-0x00a980000  0x00040000  version_info
#   0x00a980000-0x00a9c0000  0x00040000  vd_restore
#   0x00a9c0000-0x00aac0000  0x00100000  anm_logo
#   0x00aac0000-0x020000000  0x15540000  userdata
#   total=0x20000000
